UK shopper paid £15 for royal family ring; it later sold for £5,500
description: In a remarkable find, a shopper in Leicester stumbled upon a gold mourning ring at a charity shop, purchasing it for just £15. Auction experts linked the ring to Princess Amelia, revealing its royal connection. The ring, crafted in her honor, fetched an impressive £5,500 at Hansons Auctioneers, igniting a fierce bidding war that exceeded estimates, underscoring its historical significance within the royal family's mourning traditions.

title: New York charity accused of using nearly $100,000 in veteran donations for insiders
description: A New York veterans' charity called Healing for Heroes allegedly misused donations intended for injured service members. State prosecutors filed a civil lawsuit claiming founders misled donors while using funds for personal luxuries. Investigators found that the charity operated retreats only for board members and their friends, neglecting actual veterans seeking support. Additionally, the charity reportedly made almost $33,000 from rental income but did not benefit the veterans.

title: Lancashire friends built £2,000-plus gaming shed; it later won Shed of the Year
description: A tabletop gaming shed built by Chris Otterburn and his friends in Lancashire has won Britain's 2026 Shed of the Year competition. Featuring an 18-foot gaming table, storage space and a tea-making station, the shed also includes a memorial to their friend Scott Forrest, who died of cancer before its completion.

title: Delhi man with 14 criminal cases shot dead, CCTV captures killing
description: Mosin Khan, known for his extensive criminal background, was shot in Delhi and later died in the hospital due to his injuries. The police were alerted to the incident and have since launched an investigation at Ranhola police station. Currently, authorities are exploring the motives behind the shooting and actively pursuing the suspects involved.

Ashwin reveals what drove Bhuvneshwar's India comeback
description: Bhuvneshwar Kumar's selection for the T20I series against New Zealand showcases his impressive form with RCB. Ravichandran Ashwin emphasized that Bhuvneshwar concentrated on honing his skills instead of aiming for a comeback on the national team. Ashwin is optimistic about India's prospects in the upcoming 2027 ODI World Cup, attributing this to solid bowling assets and seasoned hitters. He pointed out South Africa's strength, citing their understanding of local conditions.

title: Germany's Nuremberg Airport suspends flights after suspected aviation emergency
description: Nuremberg Airport experienced a temporary flight suspension after receiving reports of a suspected aviation emergency. Police confirmed the aircraft from Corfu landed safely amid the investigation. Eurofighter jets accompanied the plane, ensuring safety during the landing process. Additionally, there were earlier reports of a possible drone sighting near the airport, which authorities could not verify. This follows heightened concerns in Germany regarding drone incidents near critical infrastructure.

title: Fruit farmer faced tax notice over large cash deposits in bank; what ITAT said
description: A farmer from Bengaluru faced a tax notice regarding unexplained cash deposits into his bank account. He was able to present evidence supporting his agricultural income claims, which led to a favorable ruling. The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal evaluated the documents submitted, including land records and APMC sale bills. The tribunal found that the lack of detailed records did not invalidate the farmer's claims.

title: Why Ronaldo vs Messi is now less a debate and more a tragicomedy
description: In this week's Offside, we examine how late-stage Ronaldo is becoming an embarrassment to his career.

title: Ben Affleck-backed initiative delivers 100m litres of clean water in Congo
description: In 2010, Ben Affleck established the Eastern Congo Initiative to foster development in the Democratic Republic of Congo. By 2024, this organization has provided over 100 million litres of clean water across various regions and facilitated access to essential health services for more than 400,000 individuals. The initiative’s social enterprise, Asili, is crucial in delivering sustainable services, showcasing the power of community-driven solutions in tackling humanitarian issues.

title: Flydubai attack: UAE detains 2 Maldivian pilots over links with accused co-pilot - report
description: Authorities have detained two Maldivian pilots in connection with the flydubai stabbing incident that occurred recently. The stabbing incident involved Omani co-pilot Hammam al-Hammami attacking Indian pilot Smit Machchhar with an axe. Despite serious injuries, Machchhar managed to unlock the cockpit and stabilize the aircraft with crew assistance. Investigators are exploring al-Hammami's alleged extremist links and how he was hired by flydubai.

title: ‘No amount of denial can change the fact’: MEA's firm message to China on Ladakh
‘Not invited to party’: Bareilly teen stabbed repeatedly by neighbour, dies
description: In Gokulpur village, a 17-year-old boy named Arjun was fatally stabbed by his neighbor after a dispute. The disagreement arose when Vishal, who was allegedly drunk, was upset over not being invited to a birthday party. He confronted Arjun, who attempted to calm him down but was violently attacked instead. Angry villagers subsequently assaulted Vishal and locked him in a house until police arrived.

title: Hailee Steinfeld’s NSFW cheer goes viral after Josh Allen’s clutch Bills play
description: On October 12, 2026, Hailee Steinfeld was filmed visibly celebrating a phenomenal play by Josh Allen during an NFL match. Her lively reaction came at a pivotal moment right before a touchdown, showing a stark contrast to her usually discreet support at games. This unexpected burst of enthusiasm highlighted her genuine love for the sport and showcased a more personal side of her fandom in front of the cameras.

title: Most Americans think Trump is profiting from presidency unethically or illegally
description: A recent poll revealed that a majority of Americans think Donald Trump is profiting illegally or unethically from his presidency. The survey indicated that around 60% of respondents believe Trump is prioritising personal financial interests over helping regular citizens. Financial disclosures suggested Trump has received significant investments in cryptocurrency ventures since returning to office. Concerns about Trump's financial conduct varied widely among political affiliations, with many Democrats alleging wrongdoing.

title: Long Island’s 127-room Oheka Castle heads to auction with $63.5m debt
description: Oheka Castle, the largest residence on Long Island, will be auctioned on 27 October. The mansion, designed in 1919, is burdened with over $63.5 million in debt. Since its purchase in 1984, the current owner invested about $50 million in restoration efforts. The property also has development potential with approved plans for 95 luxury condominiums. Prospective buyers must provide a $750,000 deposit to participate in the auction.

title: US issues power grid emergency in 13 states: Reason and what it means for residents
description: In a decisive move to ensure grid stability during a peak demand period, US Secretary of Energy Chris Wright has empowered PJM Interconnection to manage local power generation units from October 13 to October 16. With temperatures hitting unseasonably high levels, demand has surged to approximately 111,500 megawatts on October 13. While residents are not required to take action, voluntary conservation measures may be recommended.

title: Venomous snakes more likely to have conspicuous colours, study finds
Simon Cowell donated £25,000 to help rescue over 200 dogs from meat farm
description: In 2018, Simon Cowell donated £25,000 to Humane Society International to help close a dog meat farm in South Korea. The charity rescued nearly 200 dogs and puppies, including animals suffering from untreated injuries and poor living conditions. The dogs were sent to shelters in the US, UK, Canada and the Netherlands for care and possible adoption.

title: Aaron Donald’s fight with O’Cyrus Torrence sparks fan backlash over NFL comeback
description: Aaron Donald faces fresh scrutiny after his heated clash with Buffalo Bills lineman O’Cyrus Torrence during Monday Night Football. The Los Angeles Rams defensive tackle grabbed Torrence’s facemask before players stepped in to separate them. The incident came during Donald’s comeback season after two years of retirement. With the reason behind the confrontation still unclear, attention remains on his conduct and performance.

title: Arijit Singh’s ‘Phir Se’ from ‘Dhurandhar’ makes Grammy consideration list
description: Arijit Singh's enchanting track 'Phir Se' from the movie 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' is making waves as it garners Grammy consideration. Taking to social media, the talented singer thanked his devoted fans for their unwavering support. The Grammy campaign features multiple tracks from the film, showcasing a desire for enhanced global recognition. With a captivating score by Shashwat Sachdev, this blockbuster franchise has amassed an impressive Rs 3,000 crore worldwide.

title: ‘Papa, please save me’: Shekhar Suman remembers son Aayush’s final moments at 11
description: Shekhar Suman shared his struggles while his son Aayush battled a terminal illness at a young age. He faced significant emotional and financial challenges during this difficult time and continued working despite the personal turmoil. Aayush's poignant last words and the family's decision to ease his suffering haunt Shekhar even years later. Shekhar expressed that the tragedy has permanently affected their lives and remains a part of their everyday experiences.

title: ‘Biggest red flag’: BJP targets Rahul Gandhi over CEC row, alleges track record of bribery
Sensex ends 1,100 points higher, investors richer by Rs 4.12 lakh crore: Why markets are up today
description: Stock market rally today: BSE Sensex ended the day at 73,033.78, up 1,109 points or 1.54%. Nifty50 closed at 22,721.95, up 359 points or 1.60%.The rally added more than Rs 4.12 lakh crore to the combined market capitalisation of listed companies, taking the total to Rs 470 lakh crore.

title: Maharashtra man beats wife to death, walks into police station to confess
description: In Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, a man named Mukesh Kumbhakarna allegedly killed his wife, Rohini, during an argument. The couple had recently returned to Kannad town for the festive season. Following the incident, Kumbhakarna went to the local police station and confessed to the crime. Authorities have registered a murder case against him and an investigation is currently ongoing.

title: Ohio brothers bought flooded quarry for $330,000; village later drops seizure bid
description: Two Ohio brothers bought a flooded quarry for $330,000 in 2005 and spent 15 years improving it before a dispute with the Village of Luckey disrupted their planned sale. After nearly five years of litigation, the village abandoned its attempt to acquire the property through eminent domain but now faces a $206,000 legal bill, with the settlement still under dispute.Is this conversation helpful so far?

title: Grand Canyon trout removal helps native fish populations rise over 400%
description: Historically, Bright Angel Creek was a sanctuary for various native fish species, including the endangered humpback chub. However, the rise of non-native brown trout has threatened this ecosystem. In an effort to restore balance, the Bright Angel Creek Trout Reduction Project was initiated, successfully eliminating invasive trout and leading to a remarkable 400% increase in native fish populations.

title: Sergey Brin is biggest donor against California wealth tax; could owe $13 billion
description: Sergey Brin has donated $102 million to oppose California's proposed wealth tax during the upcoming election. Brin's contributions aim to combat a measure that could impose a 5% tax on billionaires. Other wealthy individuals, including Eric Schmidt and Peter Thiel, have joined Brin in opposing this tax. Governor Gavin Newsom also expresses concern about potential impacts on the state's economy and public services.

title: South Korean employer paid him salary in dollars; tax department sends notice
description: A Karnataka man working in South Korea faced an income tax notice over his salary deposited in an NRE account in India. The Income Tax Assessing Officer claimed the salary was taxable in India due to his employment. However, the ITAT Bangalore found that the man had established his non-resident status.

title: Michael Dell-backed firm spent $375m upgrading Boca Raton resort; 40% condos sold
description: An impressive $875 million investment is set to transform The Boca Raton resort into a luxurious haven of residential condominiums. With around 40% of these high-end residences already reserved, pricing starts at $8.95 million and can exceed $20 million. This revitalization forms part of the resort's centennial celebrations scheduled for 2026, with construction commencing the same year and concluding by 2029.

title: Travis Kelce's mother Donna opens up about supporting Jason's children
description: Travis Kelce and Jason Kelce’s mother Donna Kelce reflects on her life.

title: Tyreek Hill’s Chiefs reunion: Why are Kansas City eyeing their former star?
description: The Kansas City Chiefs are set to bring in Justin Watson for a meeting at their training facility. As they look to enhance their receiving lineup amidst Tyreek Hill's uncertain situation, Watson's prior experience with their offensive system could offer critical support, even if he can't match Hill's explosive abilities. The team plans to assess both Watson's potential fit and Hill's status before finalizing any roster moves.

title: In a rare, all parties in Punjab hail CEC, 'transparent' SIR exercise
description: Punjab’s final electoral rolls have recorded a net decline of 13.60 lakh voters from the pre-SIR electorate, but the revision has drawn rare cross-party praise. Representatives of the AAP, Congress, BJP and SAD commended Chief Electoral Officer Anindita Mitra for transparency, consultation and addressing their concerns. Their endorsement comes amid protests against the Election Commission elsewhere, offering a striking contrast as Punjab’s voter list settles at just over 2.01 crore electors.

title: No AC, yet naturally cool: Begum's 149-year-old palace now lies in ruins
description: Benazeer Palace, built in 1877, was once a symbol of architectural marvel and royal heritage. The palace features a unique cooling system using natural airflow and has many beautiful halls that remain intact. Despite undergoing restoration, it has not been effectively utilized and faces deterioration today. There was a proposal to transform it into a heritage hotel, though progress remains uncertain.

title: Naomi Osaka reveals how daughter Shai changed her life beyond tennis
description: Naomi Osaka has opened up about her mental health struggles, crediting motherhood and her daughter, Shai, with helping her find happiness beyond tennis. The four-time Grand Slam champion revealed how her perspective has changed since her 2021 French Open withdrawal, when she disclosed her battle with depression and anxiety. After defeating Maria Timofeeva at the China Open, Osaka reflected on personal growth, gratitude and learning to balance her professional career with life outside tennis.
